lines.text: As Jesus and His disciples leave Jericho with a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus sits beside the road.
Hearing that it is Jesus of Nazareth, Bartimaeus cries out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
Many people tell him to be silent, but he cries out all the louder.
Jesus stops and says, "Call him," and Bartimaeus throws off his sandals and comes to Jesus.
Bartimaeus asks to walk again, and Jesus says his faith has healed him, so he follows Jesus.
